mapper.sql: posting_no, posting_title, posting_content, deadline, always_open, posting_status, created_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM sgtransit_job_posting
ORDER BY created_at DESC, posting_no DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sgtransit_job_posting (posting_title, posting_content, deadline, always_open, posting_status, created_by) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{deadline}, #{alwaysOpen}, #{status}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE sgtransit_job_posting SET posting_title = #{title}, posting_content = #{content}, deadline = #{deadline}, always_open = #{alwaysOpen}, posting_status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE posting_no = #{postingNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sgtransit_job_posting_document (posting_no, document_type, display_order) VALUES (#{postingNo}, #{documentType}, #{displayOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT document_type FROM sgtransit_job_posting_document WHERE posting_no = #{postingNo} ORDER BY display_order, document_type
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sgtransit_job_application (posting_no, applicant_name, phone, email, applicant_type, memo, consented) VALUES (#{postingNo}, #{applicantName}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{applicantType}, #{memo}, #{consented})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sgtransit_job_application WHERE posting_no = #{postingNo}

SELECT a.application_no, a.posting_no, p.posting_title, a.applicant_name, a.phone, a.email, a.applicant_type, a.memo, a.consented, a.applied_at FROM sgtransit_job_application a INNER JOIN sgtransit_job_posting p ON p.posting_no = a.posting_no WHERE a.posting_no = #{postingNo} ORDER BY a.applied_at DESC, a.application_no DESC

SELECT a.application_no, a.posting_no, p.posting_title, a.applicant_name, a.phone, a.email, a.applicant_type, a.memo, a.consented, a.applied_at FROM sgtransit_job_application a INNER JOIN sgtransit_job_posting p ON p.posting_no = a.posting_no WHERE a.application_no = #{applicationNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sgtransit_job_application_file (application_no, document_type, original_name, stored_name, file_path, content_type, file_size) VALUES (#{applicationNo}, #{documentType}, #{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{filePath}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize})
mapper.select: SELECT file_no, application_no, document_type, original_name, stored_name, file_path, content_type, file_size, created_at FROM sgtransit_job_application_file WHERE application_no = #{applicationNo} ORDER BY file_no
